Masterpiece digital painting of an ancient, hidden library nestled inside the hollow of a giant, ancient oak tree. The atmosphere is intensely magical, inviting, warm, and deeply cozy, evoking a mystical hidden realm.

**Scene Details:** The interior of the library is filled with thousands of richly detailed, leather-bound books lining curved wooden shelves that spiral upwards. A grand spiral staircase winds through the center, emitting a warm, inviting glow. Floating fireflies illuminate the space between the bookshelves. Worn reading chairs with plush velvet cushions are scattered throughout. Mystical runes are intricately carved into the bark walls of the tree. Softly glowing mushrooms punctuate the corners of the space. Scattered scrolls and quills rest on antique oak desks.

**Setting & Time:** Enchanted forest environment, deep autumn setting. The background features small, arched windows revealing a starlit forest outside.

**Composition & Perspective:** Wide shot, low-angle perspective, utilizing a wide-angle lens to emphasize the scale. Deep depth of field. Adhere to the golden ratio composition. Foreground features scattered books and scrolls; midground showcases the spiral staircase and warm glow; background shows the starlit forest.

**Lighting & Color:** Twilight setting. Volumetric lighting, dramatic rim lighting, and soft, warm light emanating from the fireflies and interior sources. Light should be soft and emanating from a three-quarter source. Color palette must be warm and earthy: primary colors are amber, deep brown, and forest green, accented by soft gold, moonlight blue, and fairy pink. Rich saturation with deep, atmospheric shadows.

**Artistic Style & Aesthetics:** Fusion of the styles of Greg Rutkowski, Thomas Kinkade, and Studio Ghibli. Strong influence from Art Nouveau and Cottagecore aesthetics.

**Technical Specifications:** Ultra-detailed, 8K resolution, volumetric lighting, advanced ray tracing, Octane render quality. Shot with a Hasselblad aesthetic.
